categories.main_business_segments: Global Payments operates in two primary business segments: Merchant Solutions and Issuer Solutions. Merchant Solutions provides payment technology and software solutions to merchants, primarily small- and medium-sized businesses, as well as select mid-market and enterprise customers. Issuer Solutions delivers core processing, cardholder payments, and related services to financial institutions, retailers, fintechs, and neobanks. The company previously operated a Consumer Solutions segment, which was divested in 2023.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced payments technology, cloud-based platforms, and enterprise software to enable card, check, and digital-based payments. Its offerings include point-of-sale (POS) systems, integrated and embedded payment solutions, and core processing platforms for issuers. Global Payments emphasizes cloud modernization, modular software architectures, and secure, scalable infrastructure, with significant investment in technology development and modernization.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Global Payments serves a diverse customer base, including small and medium-sized businesses, mid-market and enterprise merchants, financial institutions, credit unions, fintechs, neobanks, and retailers. Key end markets include retail, restaurants, education, real estate, healthcare, and B2B payments, with tailored solutions for verticals such as property management and fitness communities.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with a presence in North America, Europe, Asia-Pacific, and Latin America. As of December 31, 2024, approximately 56% of its workforce was in the Americas, 21% in Europe, and 23% in Asia-Pacific. The United States accounts for about 75% of total revenues, with significant operations and customers in Europe and Asia-Pacific.
categories.supply_chain_position: Global Payments primarily operates in the downstream segment of the payments value chain, acting as a merchant acquirer, payment processor, and issuer processor. It facilitates the acceptance, authorization, settlement, and funding of payment transactions for merchants and provides processing and program management services for card issuers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding cloud-based POS and software capabilities, investing in integrated and embedded payment solutions, modernizing issuer processing platforms, and leveraging AI and emerging technologies. It is executing a multi-year business transformation to streamline operations, unify its global brand, and focus on high-growth areas, with a strong emphasis on innovation, customer experience, and operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Global Payments generates revenue primarily through transaction-based fees, typically as a percentage of transaction value or a fixed fee per transaction. Additional revenue streams include software subscription and licensing fees, value-added services, and long-term processing contracts with minimums and penalties. The company also earns from equipment sales, professional services, and SaaS offerings.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Fiserv, Worldpay, Chase Paymentech, Elavon, Bank of America Merchant Services, Wells Fargo Merchant Services, Toast, Stripe, Shopify, Block, Adyen, Worldline, Nexi, Marqeta, FIS, i2c, Bill.com, and others. Global Payments is positioned as a leading global payments technology provider with a broad, differentiated product suite and strong direct and partner distribution channels, competing on technology, scale, and vertical market expertise.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the year ended December 31, 2024, Global Payments reported consolidated revenues of $10.1 billion, up 4.7% year-over-year. Operating income was $2.33 billion, with a margin of 23.1%. The company is a Fortune 500 and S&P 500 constituent, with approximately 27,000 employees worldwide. Growth is driven by transaction volume increases, acquisitions (notably EVO Payments), and ongoing expansion into new markets and verticals.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Global Payments emphasizes its ability to deliver innovative, secure, and scalable payment and software solutions tailored to diverse customer needs across geographies and verticals. Its value proposition centers on technology leadership, global reach, integrated commerce enablement, and superior customer service, enabling clients to operate more efficiently and create frictionless, best-in-class commerce experiences.
